metadata.query: Multi-step task exercising structured evidence, cross-role reflexion, preflight review, retrospective, and advocate triad

expectedPatterns.structuredEvidence: executor_finished artifacts carry evidence array with basis and confidence
expectedPatterns.crossRoleReflexion: plannerReflexionLog populated on verifier retry/reroute, fed to planner expandNode
expectedPatterns.preflightReview: verifier.reviewPlan called for tasks with >=3 nodes, concerns fed back for refinement
expectedPatterns.retrospective: planner.retrospective called when failures occurred, lessons extracted
expectedPatterns.advocateTriad: advocate argues FOR executor when verifier retry confidence < 0.7 on first attempt
